notes:
SEALED / PRE-RELEASE

Sealed is now a complete six-pack mode: browse a swipeable pack carousel, choose your Leader, rip six randomized packs, build a 40-card deck from your pool, and play it. Packs use real wrapper art, a guided swipe-to-tear seam, visible unopened-pack stacks, tuned card reveals, silver SR and gold SEC hit sparkles, rarity glows, and glowing card previews.

The Sealed deck builder has IN DECK and CARDS FROM PACKS tabs, filters and sorting, right-side hover previews, live counts, and an Advanced auto-build button. Solo opponents open and build from their own pools, with Beginner and Intermediate straying progressively further from the Advanced deck-building priorities.

CUSTOM SEALED

Custom rooms can choose a Sealed set and both players' Leaders before the first Ready check. Each player then opens a separate deterministic six-pack pool and builds privately. A second checkpoint shares Ready or Building status; either player can cancel Ready and keep editing. When both decks are ready, the host requests the start and the opponent may accept or cancel without losing the pool or deck. Version and card-data mismatches are rejected before play.

LEADERS AND CARD INFORMATION

The full Leader roster has colour and set filters, ascending or descending sorting, banned-Leader reference cards, mouse-wheel scrolling while hovered, and glowing overlay previews. Rainbow Luffy remains first and is fully defined for its special Sealed rules. Cards drawn from Life now state their ordinary printed effect even when they have no Trigger.
